summary: An ideal daily, and just as good as a Blitz. Everyone gets New York, LA, Chicago and Houston, then the fun is learning that Miami is #41 and San Antonio and Fort Worth beat San Francisco.
reasons: Casual run: New York, LA, Chicago, Houston, Dallas, Phoenix, Philadelphia and San Diego found. Lives went on Miami (#41), San Francisco (#17), Boston (#25), Seattle (#18) and Atlanta (#36), all 'oh, city proper' lessons. 8/10 with the last life on guess 13. Fan got 10/10 with Austin and Jacksonville as the near misses.
2025 estimates, correct order, clear 'city proper' wording. Common short forms (NYC, LA, Philly, Ft. Worth) all work.
Blitz is superb: 334 ranked cities, and 29 of 30 quick casual names scored.
fixes: Missing nicknames: 'DC' (#22 Washington), 'SF', 'San Fran' (#17 San Francisco), 'Indy' (#16 Indianapolis), 'NOLA' (#54 New Orleans), 'Saint Louis' (#80 St. Louis). All are unrecognized today. 'vegas' offers Las Vegas / North Las Vegas; it should go straight to #24 Las Vegas.
Unranked pool contains world cities (Tokyo, London, Toronto, Jakarta, Mexico City...) that cost a life in a US-only list. Drop non-US cities.

Junk aliases on top-10 entries: San Antonio 'Monroe May Elementary', 'Monroe may'; San Diego 'San diego beaches'; Fort Worth 'Fort Worth United Soccer Club'; Chicago 'Sister Cities Chicago', 'Land of smelly onions'; Houston 'Houstonians'.
